description.zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

> 多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段。
description.en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

> Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. A maximum of 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks can be added to all IP address whitelists.

description.zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

- 由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

- 长度为2~120个字符。
description.en:
The name of the IP address whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- It must be 2 to 120 characters in length.
The ID of the IP address whitelist template.
The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-global-security-ip-group --resource-group-id rg-0000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name test_123 --global-security-group-id g-zsldxfiwjmti0kcm0000 --gip-list 192.168.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
